info.title: Katsanto API
info.description: Katsanto's REST API, used by its web app.

post.summary: Create an account without credentials and return a setup link for it.

Single-use link (24 h) letting the user add a new passkey or set a password.
Earlier unused links for the user stop working.

get.summary: Public: what the login/registration pages should offer.

parameters.name: invite
parameters.description: Invite token from an invite link, to check its validity.

post.summary: Username-less passkey login; the options also work for the browser's passkey autofill.

get.summary: Channel info and the first page of a tab.
More videos of a channel tab.
Started but unfinished videos, most recent first.

Server-sent events. `feed` events announce new uploads from subscribed
channels: `{"channel_id": "UC…", "count": 2}`.
Videos from subscribed channels, newest first.

post.summary: Videos an unsaved filter would show (feed editor preview, quick filters).

get.summary: The user's lists, Watch later first (created on first use).

parameters.name: contains
parameters.description: A video id: each list then says whether it contains the video.

delete.summary: Delete a list. Watch later can't be deleted, only emptied.

post.summary: Add a video to the end of a list.

200.description: The user's Katsanto data as a JSON file

post.summary: Replace all recovery codes; the old ones stop working.

get.summary: Progress for the given videos (for progress bars on cards). Unwatched videos are omitted.

put.summary: Save the playback position. Sent periodically while playing and when leaving the page.

delete.summary: Forget the progress (e.g. remove from "continue watching").

get.summary: What a pasted YouTube link points to.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text; required unless `cursor` is given.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor from a previous page; the other parameters are then ignored.

post.summary: Subscribe to a channel. Its latest uploads appear in the feed within moments.

get.summary: Ids of subscribed channels (for subscribe buttons).

post.summary: Unsubscribe from several channels at once.

delete.summary: Delete a tag. Feeds that used it simply stop matching on it.

post.summary: Add or remove a tag on several subscribed channels.

get.summary: Subtitles as WebVTT (fetched from YouTube through this server).
Description, channel, chapters and related videos.
DASH manifest for the player; stream URLs point at the proxy.

parameters.name: audio
parameters.description: `opus` (in sync, for browsers that play Opus/WebM) or `aac` (default, plays everywhere).

post.summary: Hide a video from feeds ("not interested").
Mark a video as watched without playing it.

added.description: False if the video was already in the list.

passkeys_unavailable_reason.description: Explains how to enable passkeys when they are unavailable.

invite_valid.description: Whether the `invite` query parameter is a usable invite.

needs_setup.description: No accounts yet: the first registration creates the admin.

passkeys_available.description: Passkeys work on this instance (HTTPS + domain name, or localhost).

ByteRange.description: Inclusive byte range, as used in DASH `indexRange` / `Initialization@range`.

CaptionTrack.description: A subtitle track, served as WebVTT by this server.

id.description: Track id for the captions endpoint, e.g. `en` or `en.asr`.

note.description: Who the invite is for, shown in the admin list.

CreatedLink.description: A one-time link; the secret is only ever shown here.

setup_link.description: Send this to the user so they can set up a passkey or password.

name.description: Name for a newly registered passkey, e.g. "iPhone".

ErrorBody.description: Error body of every failed API request.

Features.description: Optional integrations this instance has switched on.

FeedFilter.description:
Which videos a feed shows. Every field is optional; the default shows
everything from all subscriptions except Shorts.

channels.description: Channels to include besides the tagged ones.

tag_ids.description: Only channels with any of these tags (or listed in `channels`).

title_any.description: Title contains any of these (case-insensitive). Empty: no restriction.

title_regex.description: Case-insensitive regular expression the title must match.

icon.description: An emoji or short text shown with the name.

ids.description: Feed ids in the new order.

cursor.description: More results after this; `null` when the feed is exhausted.

ImportResult.description: What a restore added; anything already in the account is left as it is.

passwords_enabled.description: Allow passwords as a fallback to passkeys.

contains.description: With `?contains=`: whether the video is in this list.

remove_watched.description: Videos are removed once watched to the end.

used_recovery_code.description: Set when logging in used a recovery code: the user should add a new passkey or password.

after.description: Place the video right after this one; `null` moves it to the top.

ResolvedUrl.description: What a pasted YouTube URL points to.

cursor.description: Opaque token for fetching the next page.

action.description:
`skip`, `mute`, `poi` (a highlight: a single point) or `full` (the whole video is
e.g. sponsored).

recovery_codes.description: Shown once; store them somewhere safe.

id.description: Unique within a [`Playback`]: the itag, plus the audio track for multi-language videos.

fetch_error.description: Why the last refresh failed, if it did.

fetched_at.description: Last refresh; `null` until the first one.

color.description: One of the palette names (`red`, `blue`, …) or empty.

TextPart.description:
A piece of a video description. YouTube links are resolved so the app can
keep them inside Katsanto (and turn timestamps into seeks).

VideoBranding.description: A DeArrow title and/or thumbnail; videos without one are left out of the response.

published_at.description: Unix timestamp, when YouTube provides an exact date.

published_text.description: Relative date as displayed by YouTube ("3 days ago").

VideoInfo.description: Watch-page information beyond what playback needs.

VideoPage.description: A page of videos with an opaque cursor for the next one.
